description: This file defines functions and constants for creating and handling a Feishu quick action launcher card, including event key validation, card creation, and handling quick action menu events.

methods.name: isFeishuQuickActionMenuEventKey
methods.description: Checks if the given event key matches one of the predefined quick action menu keys.

methods.name: createQuickActionLauncherCard
methods.description: Creates a Feishu quick action launcher card with buttons for Help, New session, and Reset.

methods.name: maybeHandleFeishuQuickActionMenu
methods.description: Handles the quick action menu event, sends the card if the event key matches, and logs the outcome.
